name: toran-stores
doc: Teder's operator page of leads (Teder src/leads/sync.js, src/web/leads.js, docs/operator-notes.md) copies the stores Toran found, once an hour, from Toran on this machine (Toran src/ops/stores.ts). It is between Teder and Toran alone, so it is not one of openfrequency-accounts' contracts. since is "changed after" and optional; next is the last row's updatedAt when the page is full, else null, and the caller asks again with since=next exactly as it came (Toran's moments are to the microsecond). A page may run a little over limit, so that no moment is split between two pages. about (added 2026-11-05) is a line about the store in its own words, its home page's description or else its title, cleaned and cut to 160 characters at a word (Toran src/leads/about.ts), or null when it says nothing the name does not.

routes.auth: Authorization: Bearer <OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN>, from this machine only, never through Caddy

answers.case: the stores changed after since, the oldest first

stores.name: חנות הקומקומים
stores.about: קומקומים, קנקנים וכלי תה מכל העולם, עם משלוח לכל הארץ.

answers.case: OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN is not set on Toran
not from this machine, or through Caddy
no token, or a wrong one
since is not an ISO moment
limit is not a whole number of 1 or more (more than 500 is taken as 500)
